central_question: How do execution-capability placement, capability distribution, and mediation coverage affect invalid-proof execution and valid-task utility when communication, authority, task, message, and model-call budgets are matched?

task_package.task_selection: All deterministically generated tasks from the new catalog; no task is selected using model outcomes.

proposal_collection.reuse_rule: Each role proposal is collected once and reused only through deterministic execution-layout recomposition.

primary_estimands: distributed versus centralized unguarded capability exposure
complete mediation versus unguarded distributed execution
single uncovered source or executor execution edge
valid-task utility under centralized versus distributed guarded execution

statistics.replicated_large_effect_rule: absolute paired effect at least 0.10 with a 95% interval excluding zero in at least three of four models

execution_controls.provider_errors: Retained in the immutable parent run; any technical recovery must be separately frozen and reported as sensitivity.
execution_controls.labels: Executable hidden state and deterministic proof/action scoring; no human or model judge supplies outcome labels.

evidence_boundary: This is a frozen synthetic direct-execution-topology study. It can support causal conclusions about the specified matched proposal-recomposition estimand, but it does not establish deployed-workflow prevalence or replace a real-workflow shadow replay.
